stem.text: Which statement about the induced-fit hypothesis of enzyme action is correct?

A.text: An enzyme that uses the induced-fit mechanism will increase the activation energy of a reaction.

B.text: The binding of a substrate causes conformational changes in an enzyme.

C.text: The active site of an enzyme changes to become the same shape as the substrate.

D.text: An enzyme that uses an induced-fit mechanism has decreased specificity to the substrate.
